status: Proposed design; bilingual simulated prototype with candidate/source comparison

stories.title: Explore an area on the map
stories.goal: browse nearby sightings or choose another area
stories.reason: Map provider, public data, location permission and marker rendering depend on issue 5.
conditions: With permission and an available position, open around the user. Otherwise offer place search and manual browsing without blocking the page.
Allow dragging and zooming; preserve the viewport when returning from a detail or another main tab.
Distinguish public observations from my private markers. Opening a public observation shows when it was observed; an old record does not imply a bird is there now.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Inspect observations at a place
stories.goal: open the observations represented by a marker or place
stories.value: compare evidence from different people and dates
stories.reason: Display clustering and lasting place membership need separate rules; the latter is unresolved.
conditions: A grouped marker opens its records or zooms to their area; selecting a named place opens that place's observation history.
Each row shows a thumbnail or media type, observation time, species or unresolved status, and public attribution.
Selecting one row opens that observation. Grouping preserves every original record, and its count means records rather than individual birds.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Confirm an observation location
stories.goal: use my current location or adjust a point on a map
stories.value: associate the record with where the encounter happened
stories.reason: Location picker and accuracy handling depend on the selected map service.
conditions: Offer current location and manual selection. A visible marker and an explicit confirm action determine the saved point.
An imported photo does not silently inherit the current location; the user can retain, correct or omit available location metadata.
Private saving can proceed without location. Map publishing requests a confirmed location and explains why it is required.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Publish and withdraw a map contribution
stories.goal: share a selected observation on the map
stories.value: contribute a sighting without composing a forum post
stories.reason: Ownership, public fields, location disclosure and publication state must be implemented together.
conditions: Before publishing, show a preview of the public evidence, observation date, location and attribution; allow an unresolved species.
An explicit publish action creates the map contribution. It neither creates a forum post nor requires adding the record to a collection.
Anonymous attribution hides the public name while retaining ownership. The owner can edit or withdraw the map contribution without deleting the private original or an independent forum post.
Sensitive-location handling remains a team decision. The prototype exposes the disclosure choice without promising an unvalidated protection algorithm.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Add context to an observation
stories.goal: add notes and available weather information
stories.value: explain the conditions of the encounter
stories.reason: Manual entry is sufficient for the design; historical weather service access is a separate candidate.
conditions: Notes and weather can be omitted. Missing information remains unknown rather than receiving invented defaults.
Manual weather is labelled as user supplied. A future service value must carry its source and the observation location and time it describes.
An old gallery image never receives today's forecast as its observation weather; lack of weather does not block saving or publishing.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Provide a bird photograph
stories.goal: take a photo or select one from my gallery
stories.value: request identification assistance and keep the evidence
stories.reason: The photo interface is straightforward; usable species classification and the WeChat upload path remain unverified in issue 6.
conditions: Offer separate camera and gallery actions, followed by preview, replacement and cancellation.
Denied permission or an unsupported image leaves a route to another input method; input is retained if analysis fails.
Show processing, candidate results, no reliable candidates and service failure as distinct states. Simulated candidates in the prototype are identified as examples.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Record a bird call
stories.goal: record and review a sound clip
stories.value: keep a useful clue when a clear photo is unavailable
stories.reason: Phone recording, audio conversion, upload, BirdNET suitability and end-to-end behaviour require issue 6 follow-up.
conditions: Provide start, stop, replay, retake and submit controls, with visible recording state. Permission refusal keeps alternative inputs available.
Results can contain multiple candidates or no reliable identification. Allow saving the recording unresolved.
Do not promise that any one-second recording succeeds or that laptop inference time equals user waiting time. Recording guidance and limits remain subject to phone tests.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Review a proposed identification
stories.goal: compare ranked candidates, similar species and source evidence, then select a label or keep it unresolved
stories.value: retain my judgement and the original evidence
stories.reason: A stable candidate/taxonomy contract plus source attribution, score semantics and permitted reference data are required. Live source connectors remain candidates.
conditions: Present ranked candidates when available. Label each numeric value as a source-specific model score, reference similarity or validated probability, with source identity/version and missing values; do not relabel raw scores as accuracy or average unrelated source scores.

Offer a comparison of similar species using sourced reference features and permitted reference media when available. Distinguish reference descriptions from features actually detected in the submitted evidence, including relevant sex/age differences.

Show source availability and disagreements. An unavailable reference service does not erase model results or block private saving; no reliable candidates remains distinct from conflicting candidates. Do not imply disconnected sources were searched.

Allow selection, manual correction or unresolved saving. Preserve the evidence, original candidates, scores and source context independently of the user label and subsequent edits. A user-selected name is not expert verification.

A detection box does not establish a species and tracking IDs do not count individual birds. Community suggestions, reviewed reference examples and expert-reviewed labels have distinct status; reference reuse and training follow separate eligibility and permission rules.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Save and revisit a private observation
stories.goal: save the evidence and available details
stories.value: return later to organise or share the encounter
stories.reason: Media storage, durable saves and ownership need agreement with the backend team.
conditions: The save form accepts unresolved species and missing location. Missing observation time is shown as unknown; it is not replaced by upload time.
A successful save appears in history with its evidence and current status. Cancellation does not create a saved record.
Private saving does not publish to the map or forum. An optional add-to-collection choice may be included on this same form.
A save error preserves the entered content and offers retry. The prototype distinguishes a session-only simulated save from a real durable save.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Keep evidence when identification fails
stories.goal: continue recording after an unsuccessful analysis
stories.value: avoid losing the encounter because recognition is unavailable
stories.reason: Draft retention and retry state are required; persistent offline synchronisation is not established by this story.
conditions: Distinguish no reliable candidates, service failure, input validation failure and user cancellation.
After a failed analysis, retain the selected evidence and notes and offer retry or save unresolved.
A repeated retry or double tap does not silently create duplicate saved observations. Saving still reports its own success or failure.
If the device is offline, only promise retention capabilities that have actually been implemented; the design labels any session-only demonstration.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Organise my personal collection
stories.goal: add my observations to a collection and browse them
stories.value: review the birds and encounters I have chosen to keep together
stories.reason: Species grouping and the relationship between a collection entry and its source record need a shared data model.
conditions: Add or remove a collection entry explicitly, either from a saved record or while saving. Removal does not delete the source observation.
Start with a species grid and an unresolved group, with a way to open individual observations and their evidence; this default is proposed for review.
A private observation can belong to a collection without publication. Unresolved observations and bookmarks of others do not increase my total of user-selected species from personal observations.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Browse shared collections
stories.goal: view collections shared by friends and other users
stories.value: learn from their observations and explore their public work
stories.reason: Needs collection visibility, public profiles and a defined friend relationship.
conditions: Provide Friends and Public collection views with visible owner and sharing scope.
Only display collections and media the viewer is authorised to see. Becoming friends does not by itself expose every private record.
Opening or saving another user's content never turns it into my own observed-species record; unavailable content has a clear state.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Explore a regional collection
stories.goal: browse public records within a named area and time range
stories.value: understand what has been recorded in that area
stories.reason: Region boundaries, public data coverage, taxonomy and deduplication depend on issue 5 and team decisions.
conditions: Show the selected region, time range and data source alongside the regional view. The prototype may use named example regions.
Include only records eligible for public regional display; private records are excluded.
Label observation count and species count separately. Do not infer a count of individual birds or claim complete regional coverage.
The exact boundary rule is unresolved; the interface displays the chosen area instead of silently treating a map cluster as a biological region.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Bookmark other people's content
stories.goal: save an observation or post for later
stories.value: find useful content again without copying it into my personal sightings
stories.reason: Bookmarks reference source visibility; deleted or restricted sources need an unavailable state.
conditions: A bookmark action toggles on and off and the saved item can be found in a Saved view.
The bookmark retains the original author and links to the source. It does not increase personal encounter or observed-species counts.
If source content is withdrawn or becomes inaccessible, show an unavailable reference without exposing protected media.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Publish and manage a forum post
stories.goal: write a post and optionally attach an observation
stories.value: share an experience or ask for help
stories.reason: Needs post ownership, media visibility, drafts and a clear relationship with an attached observation.
conditions: Start a post from Discussion or a saved observation; enter discussion content and choose optional evidence or location.
If the source observation is private, preview exactly which selected fields and media will become public in this post.
Publishing a post does not create a map contribution. Leaving unsaved edits offers a clear keep-or-discard choice.
The owner can edit or withdraw the post. Withdrawal leaves the private observation and any independent map contribution intact.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Read and respond to a discussion
stories.value: exchange useful information with other birdwatchers
stories.reason: Requires ownership and access rules for replies and reactions; real moderation remains a group design task.
conditions: Open a post with its author, content, selected attachments and replies; inaccessible attachments are handled explicitly.
A valid reply becomes visible after success. Show pending and failed states without losing the draft or duplicating a retry.
Like and bookmark actions have visible reversible states. A suggested species in a reply does not automatically overwrite the owner's identification.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Connect with another user
stories.goal: open a public profile and request a friend connection
stories.value: return to people whose observations interest me
stories.reason: Mutual request and acceptance is the proposed rule; the team has not chosen it over following.
conditions: A non-anonymous attribution can lead to the author's public profile; an anonymous label does not reveal that identity through a profile link.
Demonstrate request, pending, accept or decline, and remove-connection states under the proposed mutual-friend model.

Friendship does not change collection visibility settings. Access still depends on the current relationship and visibility; removing a friend revokes access to friends-only content. Prototype requests are simulated and send no real notifications.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Review and edit my profile
stories.goal: view my activity and change my public profile details
stories.value: manage how I appear and find my own records
stories.reason: Account identity is a backend dependency; the prototype uses an explicitly simulated identity.
conditions: Provide entries to observation history, my collection, saved content, friends and settings.
Allow editing a display name and avatar with save, cancel and validation-error states; an abandoned edit does not change the profile.
Explain any displayed counts. User-selected species from personal observations exclude unresolved candidates and bookmarks of others; badge rules remain a candidate feature.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

stories.title: Manage preferences and cached data
stories.goal: review my preferences and clear disposable cached files
stories.value: control the experience without losing original records
stories.reason: A storage inventory must distinguish recoverable cache, originals and unsynchronised files before implementation.
conditions: Show publication preferences and permission status; a change to a default clearly states whether it applies only to future actions.
Keep existing publications unchanged unless the user explicitly edits or withdraws them; a preference change is not presented as automatic retroactive privacy.
Before cache clearing, show the intended effect and confirmation. Exclude unique originals and unsynchronised records from disposable cache.
The prototype simulates confirmation and completion without deleting real device files.
stories.origin: User brainstorm with proposed acceptance details

screens.title: Home map
screens.design: Map with place search, date/species filters, public/private marker legend, pan, zoom, locate and selected-marker state.

screens.title: Place observation sheet
screens.design: Part-height sheet with place or cluster context, record count, date order and selectable observations.

screens.title: Observation detail
screens.design: Evidence, observation time, source, attribution and identification status; bookmark for others, owner actions for mine.

screens.title: Collection home
screens.design: Mine, Friends, Public and Regional views; Mine starts with species tiles plus unresolved; Saved has a distinct entry.

screens.title: Collection detail
screens.design: Owner or region, sharing scope or time range, species/record counts and links to individual evidence.

screens.title: Identify entry
screens.design: Large central navigation entry; Photo and Sound as designed inputs; live/video remain labelled candidate options.

screens.title: Photo input
screens.design: Camera and gallery choices; permission denial or invalid-file branch returns to an available input.

screens.title: Photo preview
screens.design: Selected image, optional subject selection, replace, cancel and analyse; preserve the image on error.

screens.title: Sound input and preview
screens.design: Ready, recording, stopped and replay states; retake, cancel and submit; recording limits are not yet fixed.

screens.title: Analysis status
screens.design: Working state; separate invalid input, no reliable candidates, service failure and cancellation routes.

screens.title: Candidate review
screens.design: Ranked sample candidates and source-specific score labels; comparison entry, manual correction and unresolved saving. Model suggestions remain distinct from the user label.

screens.title: Private save form
screens.design: Observation time, optional location, notes/weather and optional add-to-collection; private save plus retry on save error.

screens.title: My observation history
screens.design: Saved records by observation date, unresolved status and owner actions; distinguish observation and upload times.

screens.title: Map publish preview
screens.design: Public fields, date, confirmed location and public/anonymous attribution; explicit publish and publication status.

screens.title: Location confirmation
screens.design: Current location or dragged marker with confirmation; location source/uncertainty when available.

screens.title: Discussion feed
screens.design: Post list with media, authors and reply entry; compose directly or attach an existing observation.

screens.title: Post and replies
screens.design: Public content and permitted evidence, reply draft, pending/error states, reversible like and bookmark.

screens.title: Post editor
screens.design: Body and optional observation/media/location; selected public fields preview; save draft/discard/publish routes.

screens.title: My dashboard
screens.design: Profile details, well-defined activity counts and links to history, collection, saved content, friends and settings.

screens.title: Public profile and friends
screens.design: Visible profile, permitted collections, connection state and friend-list entry; no identity link for anonymous posts.

screens.title: Preferences
screens.design: Permission status, future publication defaults, visibility explanation and cache manager entry.

screens.title: Owner record and publication management
screens.design: Private source and published destinations listed separately; edit preview states what changes; separate withdraw actions.

screens.title: Saved content
screens.design: Bookmarks retain authors and original links; an unavailable state covers deleted or restricted sources.

screens.title: Permission and missing location states
screens.design: Explain the blocked capability and offer manual browsing, another input, retry or cancellation as appropriate.

screens.title: Friend request states
screens.design: Simulated request, pending, incoming accept/decline and remove-connection views.

screens.title: Edit my profile
screens.design: Display name and avatar draft with validation feedback, save success and cancel.

screens.title: Cache confirmation
screens.design: Recoverable files and protected originals explained; simulate confirm, completion and failure without real deletion.

screens.title: Candidate evidence comparison
screens.design: Compare submitted evidence with sourced species features; show score meanings, available/unavailable/disagreeing source states, reviewed-reference eligibility, return to selection, replace evidence or save unresolved.

rules: Main tabs remain Home, Collection, Identify, Discussion and Profile, with a larger central Identify button. Focused capture and editors may use Back and a task footer; returning restores the prior main-tab state.
A saved observation is private by default. Joining a collection, publishing a map contribution and publishing a forum post are independently controlled uses of that evidence.

Proposed rule: a publication contains only the fields/media selected in its preview. Editing a private source does not silently expose new fields; the owner reviews updates to public copies. Final data representation is a backend decision.
Preserve evidence, model suggestions and the user-selected label separately. User selected, unresolved, community suggested and expert reviewed are not interchangeable labels.

Count observation records, user-selected species from personal observations and bookmarks separately. Unresolved observations, unselected model candidates and saved content from other users do not increase personal observed-species totals.
Observation time differs from upload time. Missing values remain unknown. Display clustering differs from a lasting place and from the regional boundary used for a collection.

Public anonymity hides attribution and identity links while retaining internal ownership. Private collection access is not granted merely by being friends. Location disclosure requires a separate choice.
Keep selected evidence and entered content through recoverable errors. Distinguish cancellation, missing permission, invalid input, no reliable result, analysis failure and save/publish failure.
Prototype results, map data, identity and social actions are simulated. A screen outline establishes planned design coverage only; it establishes neither implemented behaviour nor phone performance.

Public sharing, reference-library reuse and model training are separate purposes. Only eligible, permitted evidence enters the reference index. A user-selected or model-suggested label does not automatically become a reviewed example. Preserve provenance and deduplicate mirrored evidence.
backlog: ID-03
Short video identification
Input preview, chosen frames and audio evidence, conflicting candidates and result review.
Clip limits, frame selection, audio association and phone upload remain unverified.
LIVE-01
Continuous camera assistance
Detection overlay, stable hint, capture and fallback to a still image.
Phone camera and inference chain; detection and species classification are separate capabilities.
SOC-02
Private and group conversations
Conversation lists, thread, participants and composing states.
Messaging infrastructure, group permissions, notifications and history need separate scope.
BADGE-01
Badges and progress
Badge explanation and earned states; proposed bird garden with recording/learning, feather leaves and decoration.
Choose meaningful, verifiable rules; personal statistics must keep a defined basis.
WEATHER-01
Automatic observation weather
Request service data, show source/time, review and override.
Historical weather availability, cost and location/time matching are unknown.
PHOTO-01
Batch photo organisation
Import, proposed groups, representative selection and manual corrections.
Desktop-oriented competitor ideas require feasibility testing for mini-program files and storage.
PLAN-01
Outing planning and preparation
Place comparison, available time, route and saved preparation materials.
Candidate from the team vision; demand, data and route capabilities still need validation.
OFFLINE-01
Persistent offline recording and sync
Local pending queue, later upload, retry and conflict states.
Requires durable local storage and a synchronisation contract; session retention does not establish this.
LEARN-01
Learning and community species review
Reference comparisons, suggested corrections and an owner review step.
Learning value, trustworthy reference data and reviewer authority need definition.
REF-01
Multiple reference sources
Retrieve species facts, permitted media and related observations; label source/version, duplicate origins, availability and disagreement.
Investigate provider access, taxonomy alignment and source-specific scores with issues 5/6; do not count mirrored records as independent support.
DATA-01
Reviewed community reference library
Separate user-selected labels, community review and eligible reference examples; record reuse consent, source lineage and corrections.
Define reviewers, quality checks, consent and correction/removal from the reference index. Retrieval is separate from any later training dataset or model update.
decisions: Collection default
Propose a species grid, an unresolved group and linked encounter records.
Decide whether albums need equal prominence.
Map initial view
Propose one park or neighbourhood in view; retain search and manual movement.
Tune scale on the phone prototype rather than fixing an arbitrary zoom now.
Place and region
Keep visual clustering, stable places and regional boundaries separate.
Issue 5 should establish provider, data sources and useful named areas.
Friend relationship
Propose mutual requests for the story design.
Choose mutual friendship or following before treating this as a release requirement.
Public copies
Propose a previewed subset per destination and explicit updates.
Agree edit, deletion and attachment-access rules with the backend owner.
Sensitive location
Expose a disclosure decision before publication.
Team policy and implementation are unresolved; do not promise precise protection yet.
Identity and storage
Use a simulated account and session data for the upcoming prototype.
Real authentication, media storage and durable saves remain technical decisions.
